body:
_Migrated from issue #1376, filed 2026-08-04._

Follow-up from #1372 / #1373. That PR made metadata edits reach `.kepub` files, which fixes the reported case of *setting* a series. **Removing** metadata still doesn't propagate.

## Why

The two branches in `cover_enforcer.enforce_cover` don't have the same semantics:

| format | tool | field absent from the OPF |
|---|---|---|
| `.epub` / `.azw3` | `ebook-polish -o <opf>` | **cleared** (calibre applies it with `apply_null=True`) |
| `.kepub` | `ebook-meta <file> --from-opf <opf>` | **kept** — the OPF is merged over metadata read from the file |

So if a user clears a series, deletes all tags, or removes a description, the `.epub` loses it and the `.kepub` keeps the stale value. The Kobo is served the `.kepub`, so the reader still sees the field they just deleted.

## Measured

calibre 9.1, in the running container. One epub with `Series: OldSeries #3`, and an OPF carrying title/author/language but no series:

```
AFTER ebook-meta --from-opf (the kepub branch):  Series : OldSeries #3
AFTER ebook-polish -o       (the epub branch):   Series : (cleared)
```

## Not a regression

Before #1373 the `.kepub` received no metadata writes at all, so a deletion never reached it either. #1373 is strictly an improvement; it just doesn't cover the delete case, and the PR title reads as though it covers all metadata changes.

## Why it wasn't just fixed there

`ebook-polish` is unusable on a kepubify file: it re-applies calibre's own KEPUB spans over kepubify's, measured at 7016 -> ~13.5k spans with and without `-U`. Kobo keys reading positions and bookmarks off those span ids, so polishing would silently move every bookmark in every already-synced book. That's why the branch exists.

A fix needs a writer with replace semantics that leaves the content documents untouched — most likely applying the OPF via calibre's Python metadata API with `apply_null=True` against the kepub container, rather than either CLI. Worth confirming span stability the same way #1373 did before shipping.

## Repro

1. Give a book a series, let enforcement run, confirm both `.epub` and `.kepub` carry it.
2. Clear the series in the web UI and save.
3. `ebook-meta <book>.epub` shows no series; `ebook-meta <book>.kepub` still shows the old one.
title: Clearing a series or tag still doesn't reach the .kepub (ebook-meta merges, ebook-polish replaces)
